# Reddy Tours & Travels

> Maharashtra-based cab and car rental service offering Mumbai–Pune express cabs, All-India outstation taxis, local hourly packages, corporate employee transport, wedding fleets, and self-drive cars & two-wheelers. Zero surge pricing, sanitized AC vehicles, and police-verified chauffeurs.

## Key facts

- Business name: Reddy Tours & Travels
- Service area: Maharashtra, India (Mumbai, Pune, Nashik, Thane, Navi Mumbai, Kolhapur, Solapur, Nagpur, Latur, Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar, Ahmednagar/Ahilya Nagar, Alibaug) plus pan-India outstation
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 98600 13081
- Email: booking@reddytourstravels.com
- Hours: 24/7, all days
- Payment: Cash, UPI, Bank Transfer; GST invoices available
- Availability: 24x7 doorstep pickup, zero advance required for inquiries

## Services

- Mumbai–Pune Express Corridor: fixed-price one-way and round-trip cabs, toll-inclusive options, starting at ₹2,900.
- All-India Outstation: All India Tourist Permit fleet, from ₹13/km (Swift Dzire), ₹16/km (Ertiga), ₹22/km (Innova), and Tempo Traveller from ₹24/km (17/20/25 seater, AC/Non-AC).
- Local Hourly Packages (fuel and driver included): Swift Dzire 8 hrs/80 km ₹2,000, 10 hrs/100 km ₹2,500, 12 hrs/120 km ₹3,000; Ertiga 4 hrs/40 km ₹1,940, 8 hrs/80 km ₹3,200, 10 hrs/100 km ₹4,200, 12 hrs/120 km ₹5,100; Innova 8 hrs/80 km ₹4,000, 10 hrs/100 km ₹4,500, 12 hrs/120 km ₹5,700. Toll, parking and driver food extra.
- Events & Weddings: decorated luxury groom/bridal cars and guest shuttle tempo travellers.
- Corporate Employee Pick-Drop: monthly retainer contracts, centralized rosters, GST billing, background-checked drivers.
- Self-Drive: cars and two-wheelers without a chauffeur; 24 hrs / 350 km basis, ₹5/km (5 seater) and ₹7/km (7 seater) beyond 350 km, ₹150/hr beyond 24 hrs. Original Aadhaar, PAN and driving licence required at pick-up.

## Frequently asked questions

- How does WhatsApp booking work? Select pickup and drop city, choose car and date, then click "Book on WhatsApp"; a coordinator confirms car and driver details immediately.
- Are tolls and parking included? One-way Mumbai–Pune packages are toll-inclusive; outstation tolls and permits are billed at actual Fastag receipts.
- Can I book multi-city outstation tours across India? Yes, All India Tourist Permit cabs are available for multi-day interstate tours.
- How does Self-Drive work? Rent a car or two-wheeler without a chauffeur on a 24 hrs / 350 km basis; original Aadhaar, PAN and driving licence required at pick-up.
- What is the cost of a Mumbai to Pune cab? Swift Dzire ₹2,900, Ertiga ₹3,700, Innova ₹5,500 (one-way).
